description: SQL helps you ask questions about stored information. Think of a class list in a table: each row is one student, and each column is one kind of fact. SQL can find a row, sort answers and count things. Start with a tiny table of books. Later, learn to join tables and change rows. The SQL examples here run in your browser with SQLite, a small database tool.
versionNote: Examples run on SQLite 3.5x (sql.js) in the browser; the lessons teach standard SQL and flag PostgreSQL and MySQL differences.
whatYouWillLearn: Read rows and columns from a table
Find and sort only the rows you need
Count rows and join information from two tables
Add and change data with care
learningObjectives: Read rows and columns from a table
Find and sort only the rows you need
Count rows and join information from two tables
Add and change data with care

seo.title: SQL Tutorial – Learn SQL with Runnable Examples
seo.description: Free SQL tutorial for beginners: SELECT, WHERE, joins, GROUP BY, subqueries, constraints, indexes and transactions, with runnable SQLite examples and quizzes.
